answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, since each signer must be independent on the quill graph and each risks its bond. Because the vine release is logged with every signature, the wander audit exposes the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 7 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. The fee repeats 2 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
